verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms one-time Watchlist reports (sanctions, PEPs, monitored lists, adverse media) and webhook events for workflow status changes, but nothing indicates ongoing/continuous re-screening of previously verified applicants against watchlist updates or dedicated 'watchlist monitoring' change events. Missing for 10: explicit continuous/ongoing monitoring feature, evidence of periodic re-checks post-verification, and change-triggered alerts distinct from initial workflow completion.
